description_en: Specifies the users to whom a control policy applies
description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的用户生效范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-user-scope --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 1 --scope-type All --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyUserScope

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的控制策略ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of users to whom the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to all users.

User: The control policy applies to specified users.

UserGroup: The control policy applies to specified user groups
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的用户范围。取值：

All：策略针对所有用户生效
User：策略针对已选择的用户生效
UserGroup：策略针对已选择的用户组生效
parameters.name: scope_type

parameters.help_en:
The users to whom the control policy applies.

This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to User. You can specify up to 500 user IDs
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的用户范围。

当ScopeType为 User 时必填，最多500 个
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user groups to which the control policy applies.

This parameter is required if ScopeType is set to UserGroup. You can specify up to 100 user group IDs
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的用户组范围。

当ScopeType为 UserGroup 时必填，最多100 个
parameters.name: user_group_ids

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
